stem: Which sentence from the excerpt from the article “Millennials. . . So Happy Together” best supports the idea that co-working spaces result in positive interactions?
instruction: Use “Millennials. . . So Happy Together” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: In recent years, the co-working movement—along with its newer cousin, co-living—has turned into a frenzy. (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: These individuals or groups rent or pay a membership fee (monthly or daily) to work in a shared space with others. (paragraph 3)

options.label: C
options.text: Today’s co-working spaces give everyone the daily opportunity to socialize and collaborate. (paragraph 6)

options.label: D
options.text: In many ways, co-living and co-working environments operate in loco parentis. (paragraph 8)
